title: Rav Huna son of Rav Ika
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Pesachim 52b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.52b.7) Rav Safra left the Land of Israel for abroad; Rav Huna son of Rav Ika and Rav Kahana accompanied him, from which Hyman infers that he was Rabbi Abbahu’s student. In [Berakhot 43b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.43b.10) Rav Papa visited him; Rav Papa took and blessed over myrtle; Rav Huna asked him, “Does the Master not hold,” etc. In [Beitzah 15a](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.15a.10) he raises an objection to Abaye’s words.[^1]

notes.text: In [Pesachim 52b:7](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.52b.7), both Rav Kahana and Rav Huna cite Rabbi Abbahu, giving opposite rulings. In [Berakhot 43b:10](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.43b.10), Rav Huna questions Rav Papa’s order of blessings. The passage itself rejects the ruling Rav Papa ascribes to Rava, as the corresponding [Heilprin entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=981&lang=en) explains.
